messages.subject: annual emissions integration in R
parts:
I have a time series dataset of annual emissions values from the last year, about 50 datapoints that I would like to integrate to get a cumulative emissions value for the year. I'm sure there's a way to do this in R, could anyone point me to a resource. I've of course googled this topic but haven't found anything specific to my question. I can send data/more explanation if needed.

Thanks in advance,

Ryan
